n_b_input = input().split()
n = int(n_b_input[0])
b = int(n_b_input[1])
a = list(map(int, input().split()))

oddCount = [0] * (n + 1)
evenCount = [0] * (n + 1)

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    if a[i - 1] & 1 == 1:
        oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1] + 1
        evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1]
    else:
        oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1]
        evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1] + 1

lastIdx = 0
import heapq
diffQueue = []

for i in range(1, n):
    oDiff = oddCount[i] - oddCount[lastIdx]
    eDiff = evenCount[i] - evenCount[lastIdx]
    if oDiff == eDiff:
        heapq.heappush(diffQueue, abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]))
        lastIdx = i

totalSum = 0
countSelected = 0
while diffQueue and totalSum + diffQueue[0] <= b:
    totalSum += heapq.heappop(diffQueue)
    countSelected += 1

print(countSelected)
</translated_code>
